title: convert.progress
description: Notification (no id) sent by the engine while convert.page or calibrate.run is running. Informational: Rust uses it for the stage text and for liveness. Never sent after the response to the same request.

requestId.description: Id of the convert.page or calibrate.run request this belongs to.

current.description: Items done in this stage (for example layout regions recognized so far).

total.description: Items in this stage, when known.
